Maya Patel: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's surge — routing + TLS retry spike. Collecting owners/timelines for remediation. TL;DR: cross-region egress retries spiked -> LB handshake timeouts -> cascading client retries. Postmortem: https://redwood.local/postmortems/INC-2025-399
Sam K: I'll take lead on the LB config change (conn retry backoff + SNI tuning). Target: PR by EOD tomorrow. Need someone to own canary in eu-west.
Li W: @SamK I can do the eu-west canary and validate. ETA Thu 12:00 UTC.
Anton R: I'll own DNS failover probe tuning and alert thresholds. Plan: add randomized probe jitter, extend critical-route TTLs. Target PR Mon.
Rafa: I'll update the rollback playbook + emergency runbook. Also proposing a new alert: cross-region TLS handshake failures >0.5% over 5m. :eyes:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-399 linked; postmortem created by @MayaPatel. Reminder: 72h action items due.
Maya Patel: Action items (copied here):
```
- LB config tuning: Sam K - PR by 2025-04-10
- EU canary + validation: Li W - validate by 2025-04-11
- DNS probe jitter/TTL: Anton R - PR by 2025-04-14
- Runbook + alerts: Rafa - update by 2025-04-09
- Long-term routing change (sticky routes): Maya/ Sam - design doc by 2025-05-01
```
Sam K: Ack. Will post PR link here when ready.
Li W: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the canary window. Anton, can you paste the replay/traffic query so I can baseline?
Anton R: Sure: `sum(rate(tls_handshake_failures[5m])) by (region)` — will add exact dashboard & query in the PR.
Rafa: Also suggest a recurring 2-week retro for 6 weeks to watch for reoccurrence. These oscillations tend to come back if not monitored.
Maya Patel: Agreed. I'll send a calendar invite for biweekly check-ins for the next 6 weeks. Thanks all — please update the postmortem doc when PRs land.
